answer.room: an empty classic sitting room with high coffered white ceiling, wainscoted pale mint-aqua walls, a dark charcoal fireplace with stacked birch logs, tall windows with sheer white and linen curtains, and honey-toned pine floorboards

pieces.piece: a dark green velvet sofa facing the fireplace, centered on it in the middle of the room
pieces.why: the client asked for a dark green velvet sofa, and a deep forest green with a classic rolled-arm shape anchors the room and looks rich against the pale mint walls and the dark mantel
pieces.query:
Type: sofa, classic three-seater velvet sofa
Use: main seating facing the fireplace; living room
Style: classic, traditional
Materials: velvet upholstery, dark wood turned legs
Colors: deep forest green, dark wood
Shape: rolled arms, tight or buttoned back, turned legs, generous size, substantial visual weight
Feel: elegant, rich, inviting
Goes with: pale mint paneled walls, charcoal fireplace, honey pine floor, white coffered ceiling; classic sitting room

pieces.piece: two matching armchairs facing each other on either side of the fireplace, between sofa and mantel
pieces.why: a facing pair frames the fireplace symmetrically as in a classic salon, and a lighter neutral linen or velvet keeps the green sofa as the star
pieces.query:
Type: armchair, classic upholstered armchair
Use: conversation seating beside the fireplace; living room
Style: classic, traditional
Materials: linen or velvet upholstery, dark wood legs
Colors: warm ivory or soft sand, dark wood
Shape: wingback or rolled-arm silhouette, turned or tapered legs, medium visual weight
Feel: refined, comfortable, balanced
Goes with: dark green velvet sofa, pale mint walls, charcoal fireplace, honey pine floor; classic sitting room

pieces.piece: a large traditional rug under the whole seating group in front of the fireplace
pieces.why: a large rug with a traditional pattern ties the sofa and armchairs into one group and warms the bare pine floor, with green and faded red tones linking the sofa to the wood
pieces.query:
Type: rug, large traditional patterned rug
Use: anchoring the seating area by the fireplace; living room
Style: traditional, classic
Materials: wool
Colors: muted green, faded terracotta, cream, soft blue
Shape: rectangular, Persian or Oriental medallion pattern with border, large
Feel: warm, timeless, elegant
Goes with: dark green velvet sofa, honey pine floor, pale mint walls; classic sitting room

pieces.piece: a dark wood coffee table centered between sofa and fireplace
pieces.why: the requested dark wood picks up the charcoal mantel and contrasts with the light floor, and a classic rectangular shape suits the molded room
pieces.query:
Type: coffee table, classic dark wood
Use: central table for the seating group; living room
Style: classic, traditional
Materials: dark walnut or mahogany wood
Colors: dark brown
Shape: rectangular, turned or carved legs, optional lower shelf, medium visual weight
Feel: refined, solid, timeless
Goes with: dark green velvet sofa, charcoal fireplace, traditional rug, honey pine floor; classic sitting room

pieces.piece: a large framed mirror over the fireplace, centered on the chimney breast
pieces.why: a big framed mirror fills the tall chimney breast, reflects the window light and finishes the classic composition the client asked for
pieces.query:
Type: mirror, large framed wall mirror
Use: overmantel mirror above the fireplace; living room
Style: classic, traditional
Materials: carved wood frame, antique gilt or dark finish, glass
Colors: antique gold or dark bronze
Shape: tall rectangular or arched top, molded frame, large, strong presence
Feel: elegant, luminous, stately
Goes with: charcoal fireplace, pale mint paneled walls, white coffered ceiling; classic sitting room

pieces.piece: a floor lamp with fabric shade beside one armchair or sofa end
pieces.why: a classic floor lamp with a pleated fabric shade gives warm reading light at night in a room that only has a ceiling spot
pieces.query:
Type: floor lamp, classic with fabric shade
Use: reading and ambient light by the seating; living room
Style: classic, traditional
Materials: antique brass metal, linen fabric shade
Colors: aged brass, ivory
Shape: slender column stem, round base, drum or pleated empire shade, light visual weight
Feel: warm, elegant, cozy
Goes with: dark green velvet sofa, gilt mirror, pale mint walls, dark wood coffee table; classic sitting room
